mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id, note_id, ref_type, ref_id, label, created_at FROM note_reference WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND note_id = #{noteId} ORDER BY ref_type, ref_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_reference (workspace_id, note_id, ref_type, ref_id, label) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{noteId}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{label})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM note_reference WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND note_id = #{noteId}
